metadata.title: सैलाना विधायक कमलेश्वर डोडियार | Interview Kamleshwar Dodiyar | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
In this exclusive interview, Main Bhi Bharat talks to Kamleshwar Dodiyar, Member of the Legislative Assembly from Sailana, Ratlam (Madhya Pradesh). A powerful voice from the Adivasi community, Dodiyar shares his priorities and vision for inclusive development in tribal regions.

This conversation sheds light on real issues faced by tribal communities in Madhya Pradesh and beyond — from basic amenities to long-standing political demands.
